name: learnhouse-packages
description: npm packages published from the LearnHouse repo, versioned with each OSS release.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd sdk build && bun run --cwd react build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd sdk test:unit && bun run --cwd react test
scripts.check: bun run --cwd sdk sync-version:check && bun run --cwd sdk generate:check && bun run --cwd react sync:check
